purpose: Selection evidence for the 3.32 editorial narratives: which of the 1,450 polity profiles should receive the next four-column essays.

method.recordCount: POLITY records in public/data/fast/catalog.json.gz with this verifiedWikidata (excluded relation records skipped)
method.mentions: occurrences of the entity labels and record names in public/data/events.json, public/data/battles.json and editorial/city-narratives.json; Latin names match as whole words and a Chinese name does not count when the next character continues it into a longer catalogue name
method.citedFields: profile fields carrying at least one reference
method.region: documented coordinate boxes applied to record centres; a multi-region entity takes the region of most records
